title.narrative: Credit and Financial Services: Access to Markets Project

description.narrative: The project's goal is to contribute to increased incomes and enhanced economic growth in pastoralist communities. Its development objective is improved access and integration of smallholder livestock farmers into remunerative markets for their products, leading to improved and equitable returns.
